title: ClearPath Term Commitment and the Professional Services Projects Rate Discount
content:
The commitment component of the rate discount locked at signature on a Professional Services Projects time-and-materials statement of work rests on the term of the client's active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement on the signature date.

**Clause.** The commitment component of the rate discount locked at signature is 1.0 percentage point for a client whose active ClearPath agreement runs a 36-month term, 0.5 percentage point for one whose active ClearPath agreement runs a 24-month term, and nothing for any other client.

| Term of the active ClearPath agreement | Commitment component |
|---|---|
| 36 months | 1.0 |
| 24 months | 0.5 |
| any other term length | nothing |
| no active ClearPath agreement | nothing |

**Reading the clause.** Only an agreement in active status counts, and only its term in months is read; the time already served under that term plays no part.

Hypothetical illustration: a client whose active ClearPath agreement runs a 24-month term earns 0.5 percentage point; had the same agreement been in notice status on the signature date, the client would earn nothing.
